# Version 4.151.0
> **Faster raster and text paths** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 restores CPU bitmap-rendering performance while advancing to Skia m151. Color conversion, tag parsing, and shaped-text extraction do less work. New span overloads avoid substring allocations, and matching .NET 11 WebAssembly archives address linking and exception-handling mismatches.

## Breaking Changes

- **Color hex parsing rejects whitespace after the prefix** — SKColor.Parse and TryParse no longer accept whitespace immediately after # in the six- and eight-digit paths. Remove that whitespace before parsing. Case-insensitive hex parsing and outer whitespace trimming remain supported. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to m151** — Advances the bundled renderer from m150 without changing the existing C API surface. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294))

## API Surface

- **Span-based color and tag parsing** — SKColor.Parse/TryParse, SKFourByteTag.Parse, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse accept ReadOnlySpan<char> so slices can be parsed without allocating substrings. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))

## Bug Fixes

- **Scaled and tiled CPU bitmap rendering restored** — Restores the optimized legacy shader-context path for software bitmap draws that had regressed in earlier Skia milestones. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))
- **Ganesh stencil and resolve tracking corrected** — Tracks stencil clears in native coordinates, ensures preserve-mode clears occur, and unwinds dirty tracking when a resolve task does not execute. ([#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **Malformed native text cleanup corrected** — Fixes use-after-free and invalid frees when a corrupt Slug buffer fails deserialization. ([#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Faster color conversions with identical results** — SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply use managed math rather than a native transition. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **Less temporary text storage** — HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) pools its encoding buffer, while SKShaper reads glyph results through zero-copy spans instead of two temporary arrays. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **Subset decoding releases intermediate images** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) deterministically disposes the full-size intermediate when Subset returns a different image, without changing output. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly assets** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 archives and the exnref exception model for .NET 11 preview 6+ consumers. .NET 8 keeps 3.1.34 and .NET 9/10 keep 3.1.56 with their legacy exception model. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Adds span-based tag parsing and pooled UTF-8 string encoding, and ships Emscripten 5.0.6 native archives for .NET 11 consumers. The native HarfBuzz version remains 14.2.1.
